title: Comparing $NXT two financial reports and earnings call sentiment
author: Fynca
selftext:
I made this quick video showing how I compared two financial reports, identified the most important changes in the fundamentals, and analyzed how management׳s tone shifted across the latest earnings calls.

**Overall assessment:**  
The company’s position improved on balance: revenue, earnings, backlog, shipped capacity, customer reach, assets, and equity all increased, while liabilities grew more slowly than equity. The negative signal is that growth came with lower margins and greater exposure to U.S. demand, major customers, acquisitions, and policy-sensitive solar economics. The evidence therefore supports a picture of a larger, financially stronger company, but with more concentrated and operationally complex risk. The key issue for the next report is whether NXT can convert its expanded backlog and product portfolio into sustained revenue growth without further margin erosion.
